name: Principles of Electrochemical Engineering
description: Volta and Galvani potentials; solvation energy, ionic equilibrium; ion-ion interactions: Debye-Huckel theory, activity coefficient of ions, ion pair, Bjerrum theory and Fuoss theory; ionic transport: migration, electrochemical mobility; Stokes-Einstein equation, extended Nernst-Planck equation, ionic conductivity, transport number, Kohlrausch law. Charged interface: electric double layer and its models, zeta potential, energy of double layer. Electrokinetic phenomena: non-equilibrium formulation, diffusion potential, junction potential, Planck-Henderson equation, electrosmosis, electrophoresis, streaming potential, sedimentation potential. Electrochemical potential, redox reactions at electrode, electrochemical cell, electrochemical equilibrium-Nernst equation, electrode potential, reversible electrodes, pH electrode, Pourbaix diagram electrode kinetics: Butler-Volmer formulation, linearized form, Tafel equation, common electrochemical characterizations: CV, LSV, RDE, EIS. Design of porous electrodes. Design of electrochemical reactors.
